changelog:
- Initial release of Auto-Updater skill for Clawdbot.
- Automates daily updates for Clawdbot and all installed skills using a cron-based routine.
- Delivers clear summary messages after each update with details on what changed.
- Supports flexible scheduling, timezone configuration, and notification delivery options.
- Troubleshooting instructions and manual update commands included for reliability.
summary: Ensure your Clawdbot and all skills stay current with automated daily updates. This robust cron-based routine checks for, downloads, and applies updates without manual intervention, then delivers a clear summary of changes. Reliable and low-maintenance, it keeps your system secure and feature-rich,
